1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not comprise an alkali solution__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not comprise an alkali solution__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __without use of an alkali solution in the non-destructive medium__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __and the method does not employ cell wall degrading enzymes__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without use of an alkali solution in the non-destructive medium__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __and the method does not employ cell wall degrading enzymes__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from the group consisting of cellulase, pectinase, and combinations thereof, but not including gentle sonication__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a method that includes magnetic particle-based extraction__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to separate the magnetic particles from the shed cellular material__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __and the method does not employ an alkali solution in the non-destructive medium__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent condition__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed using PCR-based methods__.

14. (Originally Presented) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate phenotype with genotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __using a method that does not include the cold, heat, and agitation steps of claim 3__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to collecting shed cellular material from the one or more embryos__.

18. (Cancelled)
